title: Étale sheaf of homomorphisms between quasi-coherent pullbacks
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and M,N quasi-coherent O_X-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent]. The presheaf on the small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] given by u:U→X ↦ Hom(u^*M,u^*N), using the canonical pullback pseudofunctor [def-pc-module-pullback], is a sheaf of sets.

source.place: Modules.isSheaf_etaleHom (lines 160–167); fpqc full faithfulness, Stacks Tag 023T, restricted to the small étale site

proof.text: Full faithfulness of fpqc descent for quasi-coherent modules gives the fpqc sheaf of morphisms between pullbacks. In the existing Lean proof this is isSheaf_presheafHom.

Restrict this sheaf to the small étale site. Its coverings are fpqc, so every étale compatible family glues uniquely by the preceding sheaf condition. The upstream code implements this restriction via the continuous small-étale to pro-étale functor and proetaleTopology_le_fpqcTopology. This is the exact, already proved declaration isSheaf_etaleHom.
